text:
deploybot: starting staged rollout v2026.04.12 -> goal 5% -> 20% across regions, change window 10:30-11:00 UTC. preflight checks passed but lighthouse-safeguard flagged a metric delta in EU.
anya: flagged what exactly? where in EU?
kevin: EU-west only. signal = embed_success_drop + p90_latency +50ms. sample ~1.1% of traffic, but consistent for 3 mins.
maria: recommend PAUSE and PIN the EU canary to previous stable while we triage. keep global percent at 5%.
sam: +1 to pause. freeze bump and notify infra. we should also capture a full trace for the affected requests.
ops-bot: suggested command to pin (running if agreed):
```
# pin canary in eu-west to stable
releasectl pin --target staged --region eu-west --to v2026.03.30 --reason "lighthouse-safeguard"
```
anya: if pin succeeds we keep the rest of rollout live at current percent and investigate. rollback only if broader impact.
releasebot: preflight note: release notes at https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-04-12. attaching heartbeat and metrics link: https://telemetry.redwood/lighthouse/1932468012
ops-bot: pin command queued... executing.
ops-bot: pin SUCCESS: staged/eu-west pinned -> v2026.03.30. global rollout percent unchanged (5%). change window remains 10:30-11:00 UTC. incident created INC-2026-042.
kevin: triage steps: 1) capture traces (sam), 2) compare quantized kernels (maria), 3) run canary-eval (releasebot). if we need full rollback run:
```
# full rollback (global)
releasectl rollback --deployment staged --to v2026.03.30 --confirm
```
maria: I'll look at model runtime telemetry and quantization fallback traces. if it's a regression revert is safest.
sam: kicking off `canary-eval/2026-04-12` now. will post results in ~8m.
anya: update release notes: add blurb about "paused EU canary due to lighthouse-safeguard; investigating embed/latency regression". link to INC-2026-042.
kevin: vote check: any objections to pause+pin for now? 5m window to object.
anya: no objections :thumbsup:
maria: no objections
sam: no objections
releasebot: acknowledged. action summary: EU canary pinned to v2026.03.30, percent bump paused, incident INC-2026-042 filed, evals underway. resume or rollback will be announced in thread once triage complete.
ops-bot: holding off further automated percent increases. alert sent to oncall-sre.
kevin: moving to triage. will reconvene in 10m unless critical regression found.
